# State of AI for Buddhist texts

What AI can do today with Buddhist texts, measured on open benchmarks, and where nothing is measured yet. It is built from the benchmarks and results in this repo and in [BuddhistBench](https://github.com/BuddhistAI/buddhist-bench), and rebuilt whenever they change. For the full rankings and costs, see the [leaderboard](https://buddhistai.github.io/buddhist-benchmarks/).

## At a glance

- **Text tasks:** 10 defined, 1 with a benchmark, 1 task and language pair with results.
- **Buddhist knowledge (BuddhistBench 0.4.0):** 15 tracks planned or open, 1 with real questions, 0 with model results.
- **Other open leaderboards we follow:** 1.

- [Tibetan OCR](https://huggingface.co/spaces/BDRC/tibetan-ocr-leaderboard) (BDRC): OCR engines and models ranked on BDRC's open Tibetan OCR benchmark of woodblock prints and manuscripts.

## Gaps

- **Text tasks with no benchmark yet (9):** text cleanup, segmentation, entity extraction, citation mapping, text-translation alignment, text-commentary alignment, term extraction, translation, translation review.
- **Sanskrit:** no text task is measured yet.
- **Pali:** no text task is measured yet.
- **Classical Chinese:** no text task is measured yet.
- **BuddhistBench tracks with no real questions yet:** Core, Theravāda, Tibetan, The Thirty-Seven Practices of Bodhisattvas.
- **Traditions whose BuddhistBench track is only planned:** Chan / Zen / Seon / Thiền, Pure Land, Tiantai / Tendai, Huayan / Kegon, Shingon and East Asian esoteric, Nichiren, Indian Mahāyāna philosophy, Early Buddhism, Newar.
- **BuddhistBench tracks with questions but no model results yet:** Thai Nak Tham and Dhamma Studies exams.

## Close a gap

- Add test data for a task and language: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
- Score your tool or model on an existing benchmark: [SUBMIT.md](SUBMIT.md).
- Bring exam papers or expert questions for your tradition: [BuddhistBench](https://github.com/BuddhistAI/buddhist-bench/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- Propose a new task or ask a question: [Discussions](https://github.com/orgs/BuddhistAI/discussions).
